bar.reason: BB_M55_SKIP_LADDER=1 — the ladder's own gates are run individually by the shared verify chain in this mode (declared, never a silent pass)

limitations: The bar re-audit runs the M53 R1 ladder (m24->m44 gate chain, including both closures) as subprocesses; under heavy machine load those gates' latency budgets can miss, which this gate reports as a failed bar rather than retrying silently.
Relevance-based staleness mirrors M24.G1: a file not listed for an issue does not invalidate its evidence. The list is maintained here; a new component must be added to it when its issue lands.
The in-editor legs (V1's frames) are out of this gate's reach: it can only assert that the ledger points at evidence files, never that a frame was read by a human.
